scripts.pre_release: npm version prerelease --preid=rc -m "chore: pre-release v%s" && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
scripts.build: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:ext
scripts.build:ext: cd extension && npm run build && cd .. && node scripts/pack_ext.js
scripts.check: npm run check:daemon && npm run check:ext
scripts.check:daemon: cd daemon && go vet ./... && go test ./...
